title: Sebastian Ross (IESE School of Founders, Conscious Capitalism board) — 'an absolute must read for founders and leaders'
summary: Sebastian Ross — Co-Founder and Director of the IESE Business School of Founders and a Conscious Capitalism board member — endorses Incorruptible as a worthy sequel to John Mackey and Raj Sisodia's Conscious Capitalism.
blockquote: The book is an absolute must read for founders and leaders and a worthy sequel to John Mackey's and Raj's seminal book Conscious Capitalism.
attribution_title: Co-Founder and Director, IESE School of Founders; Conscious Capitalism board member
